notes.title: v1.082
notes.content:
Reduced the difficulty of the first level
Modified the description of quitting the game in English, sorry for the unwanted thoughts

notes.title: v1.080
notes.content:
Added some UI instructions and skill operation instructions
Tip Dash and roll are not invincible rolls, nor can they pass through the enemy, you need to bypass the enemy in the air
Reduced the physical impact of some monster attacks to avoid being hit by ping pong balls

Thank you players for your suggestions

notes.title: V1.079
notes.content:
Frame rate lock Prevents bugs and game experience inconsistencies caused by too fast frame rates, resulting in problems with high refresh rates and high-performance computers. Too fast frame rates will cause problems
Sorry for the unpleasant experience for players who have already purchased the game

notes.title: v1.077 version update
notes.content:
Reduced the back thrust of players being attacked
Increased player's initial defense
The first Elite Greatsword monster was too difficult for many novice players, so the difficulty of this monster was reduced, and the speed of the monster's shot was slowed down. Sorry for the inconvenience to new players.
Reduced the number of monsters in some locations in the first level
Increase the jumping floor area and reduce the difficulty of the first jump
